# toknt — a token-counting probe

Tokenizers split text into subword units, so the same sentence costs a
different number of tokens on each model. This sample mixes prose, source code,
mathematical symbols, emoji, and several scripts, to exercise a counter across
the kinds of input it meets in the wild — not just clean ASCII English.

## Code

```rust
fn count(input: &str, model: &Model) -> Result<Count> {
    let encoding = model.encoding()?;             // model -> tokenizer
    let tokens = encoding.encode_ordinary(input); // ordinary path: never raises
    Ok(Count { tokens: tokens.len() })
}
```

## Symbols & emoji

Math: ∑ xᵢ² ≤ ∫₀^∞ e⁻ˣ dx, π ≈ 3.14159, ∆ = b² − 4ac.
Emoji: 🦊🚀🔤🧮✅ — currency $1,000 · €750 · ¥99, an em‑dash and "smart quotes".

## Writing systems

中文：分词器把文本切成子词单元。
日本語：トークナイザーはテキストを分割します。
한국어: 토크나이저는 텍스트를 나눕니다.
Русский: Токенизатор разбивает текст на части.

That is the whole probe.
